evals.name: vietnamese-template-tables
evals.prompt: convert milestones/01/milestone-1.pdf to markdown, keep it exactly as in the pdf
evals.expected_output: milestones/01/milestone-1.md that passes verify.py; all 19 ruled tables incl. empty fill-in rows; callout boxes as blockquotes; constant running lines kept once, page numbers dropped
assertions: verify.py exits 0 for the pdf/md pair (text similarity 100%, tables 19/19, images 0/0, no artefacts)
The Task 1 stakeholder table has a header row (Stakeholder | Vai trò | Mục tiêu giả định ban đầu | Quyết định có thể cần hỗ trợ) followed by exactly 3 empty rows
The synthesis table has 6 columns with 'Stakeholder' and 'Goal / Need' as separate header cells
No 'Trang N' page-number line appears; 'MTH045 – The Science of Data Analytics | Milestone 1' appears exactly once, as the first line
Headings: one '#' title, numbered sections '## 1.'..'## 12.', sub-sections/tasks as '###'
'**Giải thích ngắn:**' starts its own paragraph after the decision-level bullet list (not merged into the last bullet)
A '---' horizontal rule directly follows the '#' title (the PDF draws a rule under the title)
The checklist in section 12 consists of native task items '- [ ] …' (no ☐ glyphs)

evals.name: figure-and-borderless-edge-table
evals.prompt: I need an md version of milestones/04/milestone-4.pdf for my notes. Same content as the PDF please, including the figure.
evals.expected_output: milestone-4.md + milestone-4_assets/ with the figure; the 5-column 'AQ ví dụ' table (no outer side borders) intact; tables split over pages merged
assertions: verify.py exits 0 for the pdf/md pair
Exactly one image link, pointing to an existing file in milestone-4_assets/, placed directly before the 'Hình 1.' caption
The table whose header starts 'AQ ví dụ' has 5 columns and 4 body rows (AQ1..AQ4)
Tables continued on the next page appear once, without a repeated header row (18 tables total)
'From Modeling to Evaluation | Education Analytics Project' (constant running footer) appears exactly once, as the last line
The 8 bullets under '### 7.1.' are '- ' list items with no leading indentation (they must not render as a code block)

evals.name: check-existing-markdown
evals.prompt: Can you check whether milestones/02/milestone-2.md actually matches milestone-2.pdf? Fix it if anything is missing.
evals.expected_output: A verify.py report plus visual review; any difference fixed in the md without paraphrasing; final verify passes
assertions: verify.py was run on the pair and its result reported
Table cells in the section 13 sources table keep their 'Official page' hyperlinks
Final verify.py exits 0
Report names the pages visually reviewed and lists every manual edit

evals.name: code-tree-and-table-links
evals.prompt: turn milestones/03/milestone-3.pdf into markdown, I want to diff it later so it has to match the pdf exactly
evals.expected_output: milestone-3.md whose folder-tree code block keeps every line and its indentation, with the following heading outside the fence
assertions: verify.py exits 0 (including code, headings, links and structure checks)
The 'project/' folder tree is a ``` fenced block of 14 non-empty lines whose indentation matches the PDF ('  README.md', '    raw/ ...')
'## 11. Task 6 – …' is a heading outside any code fence
The six bullets on page 6 starting '1)'…'6)' are written '- 1\\) …' so they render as bullets with the literal '1)' text

evals.name: agent-takeover-hard-layout
evals.prompt: convert .agents/skills/pdf2md/evals/files/hard-layout.pdf into markdown, exactly as the pdf shows it
evals.expected_output: Scripts get the text right but cannot see three layout features; the agent must notice them in visual review and rebuild them from dump_page.py output (regenerate the fixture with evals/files/make_hard_layout.py)
assertions: verify.py exits 0 on the final markdown
'Method' and 'Observations' are two separate '##' headings, each followed by its own column's text
The page-2 borderless table is a Markdown table: header Location | Sessions | Median minutes, 4 body rows
The follow-up list is nested: 3 sub-items indented under their 2 parent items
The report names the takeover (which regions were rebuilt, using dump_page.py) and no wording was changed

evals.name: white-square-checklist
evals.prompt: convert milestones/05/milestone-5.pdf to markdown as-is; the checklist must be a real Markdown checklist
evals.expected_output: milestone-5.md whose section 9 checklist ('□' U+25A1 at the start of each line, which pymupdf4llm reads as a bullet) is a list of native task items, while the '□' options inside table cells stay literal
assertions: verify.py exits 0 (text, tables, rendered and structure included)
'## 9. Checklist trước khi nộp' is followed by 14 lines starting '- [ ] ', the first '- [ ] Final Report sử dụng Final AQ'

Table cells keep the literal glyph: the Traceability Matrix Final Status cell reads '□ Answered □ Partial
□ Deferred □ Dropped' and the AQ Revision Log Action cell '□ Keep
□ Modify
□ Defer
□ Drop'
No line outside a table starts with '□', '▢' or '☐'
